results.title: Waterfall API introduction
results.snippet:

results.title: Authentication
results.snippet:
Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the `x-api-key` header. [Contact the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for API access and pricing.
```
x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```
The API host is `https://api.waterfall.io`. Data endpoints use `/v1/`; Account Reporter V2 uses `/v2/account`. Use the path shown on each reference page.
##
​
Best practices
- Store keys in server-side environment variables. Keep them out of browser code and public repositories.
- Rotate keys periodically.
- Use [dedicated sub-keys](/v1/api-keys-overview) to manage access and usage for separate teams or workflows. Creating and managing sub-keys requires a **master API key**.
Missing keys return `401`. Invalid keys return `403`; this status can also indicate that a feature or permission is unavailable to the key. Inspect the error `code` using the [Errors guide](/v1/errors). Follow the [quickstart](/v1/quickstart) to make your first request, or use [Agent Skills](/v1/skills-overview) to build with an agent.

> Enrich a known contact from a work or personal email, LinkedIn profile, or name and company domain.
Use Waterfall Contact Enrichment to add profile and contact data to a person you already know. Start with a work or personal email, a LinkedIn profile, or a name and company domain. Results can include their title, company, location, employment history, email, and optional phone numbers.

> A synchronous Contact Enrichment option is available by arrangement for enterprise customers. [Contact our team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) to discuss access.

| - | - | - |
| Email | `email` | Accepts work or personal email. Professional emails generally provide better enrichment quality. |
| LinkedIn | `linkedin` | Use the person's profile URL or slug. |
| Full name and domain | `full_name` + `domain` | Use when you have the person's name and company domain. |
| Split name and domain | `first_name` + `last_name` + `domain` | Prefer split names when both are available. |

results.snippet:
How the API works
Send requests to `https://api.waterfall.io` with your API key in the `x-api-key` header. [Authentication](/v1/authentication) covers access and key management. Prospector and the contact, phone, and company enrichment APIs return a `job_id`. Use the matching Finder to retrieve the result, or provide a `webhook_url` to receive it. Search and verification APIs return results in the same request. The [API selection guide](/v1/introduction) lists the response pattern and availability for each capability. Every reference page shows the supported inputs and outputs. Use [Usage Tracking](/v1/inline-usage) to read returned costs, and [Account Reporting](/v1/account-reporter-v2) for usage across a date range. For API access, pricing, or help choosing the right workflow, [talk to the Waterfall team](mailto:support@waterfall.io). Common product and integration questions are covered in the [FAQ](/v1/faq).

Waterfall.io is a B2B data API for go-to-market workflows. Use Waterfall to find people at target accounts, enrich contact and company records, match emails to business profiles, find phone numbers, verify email addresses, and check job changes.
###
​
Who is Waterfall for?
Waterfall serves growth, revenue, and go-to-market teams. GTM engineers build prospecting workflows, revenue operations teams fill gaps in CRM records, and product-led growth teams add business context to signups. Developers can also add contact and company data to GTM tools, recruitment platforms, CRMs, marketing software, and other products.

Waterfall has undergone a SOC 2 Type II audit covering Security, Confidentiality, and Privacy. Independent auditors also conduct our penetration tests. Those auditors also work with Snowflake and T-Mobile. Our infrastructure runs on AWS, with encryption in transit and at rest. The API supports signed webhooks so your receiving system can verify that a delivery came from Waterfall and that its payload was not changed. Webhook signing depends on the signing configuration. API access is available by approval. Enter your work email on the [Waterfall website](https://www.waterfall.io/) to request a key, or [book a call](https://www.waterfall.io/book-a-call) to discuss your workflow and pricing. A member of our team reviews every access request; we aim to reply within a couple of hours. We work with a limited number of customers so we can provide direct support and plan capacity around each team’s needs. Once you have a key, send it in the `x-api-key` header. results.title: Enrich your first contact
results.snippet:
1. Set up your API key
You need a Waterfall API key with Contact Enrichment enabled. [Contact the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for access and pricing. Requests use your account’s configured rates. Store the key in an environment variable in your terminal:
```
export WATERFALL_API_KEY="YOUR_API_KEY"
```
Keep the key on your server or in your local environment. See [Authentication](/v1/authentication) for key management.
##
​
2. Submit an email address
Replace `person@company.com` with the contact you want to look up. This request leaves phone enrichment off.
```
curl --request POST 'https://api.waterfall.io/v1/enrichment/contact' \
--header "x-api-key: $WATERFALL_API_KEY" \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data '{
"email": "person@company.com",
"include_phones": false
}'
```

--header "x-api-key: $WATERFALL_API_KEY" \

```

results.title: Search Contact Launcher
results.snippet:
Use Waterfall Search Contact to discover people and review their professional profiles. Look up a LinkedIn profile, find people at a company, or discover contacts across a filtered set of companies. Results include names, titles, companies, locations, and employment history where available. Email and phone channels are redacted.

Search modes
| Mode | Required inputs |
|---|---|
| Known LinkedIn profile | `contact_linkedin` |
| Contacts at one company | `domain`, `company_linkedin`, or `company_name` |
| Contacts across a company set | At least one of `company_location_countries`, `company_industries`, or `company_employee_ranges`, plus an experience date and `title_filters` or `title_lists` |
Company-set searches require `experience_start_date` or `experience_start_date_new_hire`. See [Search Contact filters](/v1/search-contact-filters) for these inputs, department and seniority values, and named title groups.
##
​
Example request
```

"domain": "waterfall.io",
"title_filters": [
{ "name": "founders", "filter": "founder OR co-founder OR ceo" }
],
"page_number": 1,
"page_size": 10
}
```

results.snippet:
# Waterfall.io API Documentation
> One GTM API to find prospects, enrich contacts and companies, verify emails, and check job changes. Explore use cases and API references.

- [Prospector Launcher](https://docs.waterfall.io/v1/prospector-launcher.md): Find contacts at a target company by role, with verified emails and optional phone enrichment.

- [Search Contact Launcher](https://docs.waterfall.io/v1/search-contact-launcher.md): Find professional profiles by LinkedIn, company, role, location, or hiring date, without email or phone enrichment.

- [Identify companies visiting your website](https://docs.waterfall.io/v1/use-cases/website-company-identification.md): Use Waterfall Company Reveal to connect website activity with company profiles and add company context to your account workflows.
